requirements.title: Specification identity is pinned
requirements.statement: Every verification document identifies the exact spec.md content by path, SHA-256, and source anchor so stale evidence cannot silently satisfy a changed specification.
requiredEvidence: Verifier output containing the matched spec SHA-256

requirements.title: Verification JSON is schema-valid
requirements.statement: Requirements, tests, quarantine, semantic registries, scripted model fixtures, app-container fixtures, and coverage documents validate against their checked-in Draft 2020-12 schemas.
requiredEvidence: Per-document schema validation report

requirements.title: Traceability is bidirectional
requirements.statement: Every requirement references known tests, every test references known requirements, identifiers are unique, and retired or unknown links fail verification.
requiredEvidence: Zero unknown, duplicate, stale, or unmapped IDs

requirements.title: Semantic registries are complete and enumerable
requirements.statement: The run-state, transition, approval-decision, and stable-boundary registries are machine-enumerable and their declared completeness is verified.
requiredEvidence: Finite cell, rule, unique-winner, dead-rule, security-invariant, and cross-document registry report

requirements.title: Deterministic fixtures are valid
requirements.statement: Scripted model and app-container fixtures have fixed identities, deterministic inputs, explicit behavioral oracles, and no dependency on prior test ordering.
requiredEvidence: Fixture schema report and unique fixed seeds

requirements.title: Coverage policy is enforceable
requirements.statement: Coverage floors, semantic completeness gates, mutation gates, pending baselines, and exclusions are represented without claiming unavailable evidence.
requiredEvidence: Coverage policy, baseline, and exclusion validation

requirements.title: Quarantine cannot hide critical failures
requirements.statement: P0 and security, persistence, approval, deletion, recovery, lifecycle, and required device tests cannot be quarantined; other entries expire within seven days.
requiredEvidence: Quarantine policy report with expiry evaluation

requirements.title: Missing verification evidence fails
requirements.statement: Empty test discovery, unexpected skips, crashes, timeouts, missing result bundles, or missing coverage reports fail their gate.
requiredEvidence: Negative verifier fixtures for missing discovery and result evidence

requirements.title: MLX-free dependency boundaries
requirements.statement: AgentContracts is dependency-light, AgentSandboxAPI depends only on AgentContracts, and AgentRuntime contains no SwiftUI, MLX, llama.cpp, EventKit, CoreLocation, or private sandbox dependency.
requiredEvidence: Package graph assertion and MLX-free builds

requirements.title: Deferred runtimes remain absent
requirements.statement: The first release contains no workflow interpreter, DAG scheduler, child-agent spawner, production sandbox substitute, arbitrary shell, or online model client.
requiredEvidence: Forbidden dependency and symbol scan

requirements.title: Durable identities are strongly typed
requirements.statement: Runs, steps, requests, invocations, approvals, artifacts, events, handles, commands, messages, and conversations use non-interchangeable stable identifiers.
requiredEvidence: ID round-trip, malformed input, and compile-time signature coverage

requirements.title: Public envelopes are versioned
requirements.statement: Requests, commands, receipts, events, results, sandbox messages, and persisted payloads carry semantic protocol and payload versions and fail closed on unsupported major versions.
requiredEvidence: Golden wire fixtures and unsupported-version failures

requirements.title: Run-state reducer is pure and exhaustive
requirements.statement: All sixteen specified states and every registered legal or illegal transition are handled by a pure reducer; invalid transitions fail closed and emit diagnostics.
requiredEvidence: 100% semantic transition registry coverage

requirements.title: Stable boundaries govern recovery
requirements.statement: Only committed stable boundaries are authoritative; transient token output is provisional and an interrupted model attempt restarts from its preceding stable boundary.
requiredEvidence: Before/after crash result for every registered boundary

requirements.title: Terminal outcome is unique
requirements.statement: Each run commits exactly one terminal event and one terminal reason; nonterminal waits remain resumable and background expiration is not misreported as terminal failure.
requiredEvidence: Terminal uniqueness race and reason enumeration results

requirements.title: User interaction remains in the same run
requirements.statement: A request for user input is durable, responses target its request and expected run version, duplicates are idempotent, and stale responses cannot create a new root run.
requiredEvidence: Scripted user-input fixture and journal identity assertions

requirements.title: Uncertain external outcomes block progress
requirements.statement: Unknown boundary-crossing outcomes enter waitingForReconciliation and cannot replay or continue until a targeted succeeded, failed, or abandoned resolution is committed.
requiredEvidence: Uncertain write crash and no-replay journal evidence

requirements.title: SQLite journal is canonical
requirements.statement: The transactional SQLite/WAL journal is canonical for accepted user turns, lifecycle, and committed answers; Conversation JSON is only an idempotent compatibility projection.
requiredEvidence: Transactional ordering and canonical-source assertions

requirements.title: Projection outbox is durable and idempotent
requirements.statement: Canonical message and run events commit with an outbox command keyed by stable MessageID and RunID; replay cannot create ghost or duplicate messages.
requiredEvidence: Crash matrix around user-send and final-answer projection

requirements.title: State mutation uses CAS and idempotency
requirements.statement: All state-changing commands carry stable IDs and expected run versions; duplicate outcomes return original receipts and competing callbacks cannot both advance one version.
requiredEvidence: CAS race and duplicate-command receipts

requirements.title: Explicit recovery is deterministic
requirements.statement: Resume replays committed events, verifies pinned dependencies, reuses completed results, restarts only interrupted model work, and never silently migrates incompatible authority.
requiredEvidence: Replay equivalence and incompatible-dependency outcomes

requirements.title: Conversation deletion cascades across owned data
requirements.statement: Deletion quiesces active work and removes projections, journal records, receipts, bookmarks, unshared artifacts, outbox entries, backups, and diagnostics through a replayable intent.
requiredEvidence: Cascade inventory before and after every injected failure

requirements.title: Delete All marker prevents resurrection
requirements.statement: A protected marker outside deleted roots blocks store opening until database sidecars, projections, artifacts, bookmarks, backups, and diagnostics are removed and clean stores exist.
requiredEvidence: Crash-at-each-delete-step recovery evidence

requirements.title: Local engines adapt behind a provider-neutral contract
requirements.statement: The first implementation wraps existing local engines behind capability, prepare, and generate semantics without model-family conditionals in the run state machine.
requiredEvidence: Scripted provider contracts and real-engine adapter matrix

requirements.title: Model event stream has one normalized terminal
requirements.statement: Provider streams emit normalized reasoning, answer, action, usage, completion, or failure events, exactly one terminal completion on success, and nothing after terminal.
requiredEvidence: Provider stream terminal and cancellation contract results

requirements.title: Ordinary chat stays one-pass and local
requirements.statement: A zero-tool answer uses exactly one model attempt, no planner inference, and no local-to-online fallback.

specAnchors.heading: Agent action protocol and loop policy

requiredEvidence: Pure-chat fixture with exactly one provider invocation

requirements.title: Only one root run and decode lane progress
requirements.statement: Across the app one root run owns active progress and one local engine is resident; waiting runs own no model lease and cannot silently preempt the current owner.
requiredEvidence: Competing-run lease and residency trace

requirements.title: Pause is durable quiescence
requirements.statement: Pause records interrupted work at a stable boundary, drains native generation, releases its lease, and does not strand resident model state or abandon uncertain writes.
requiredEvidence: Lease drain, journal, and reconciliation assertions

requirements.title: Each model pass yields one normalized action
requirements.statement: A pass resolves to callTools, requestUserInput, or finalAnswer; mixed prose preceding tools stays provisional and malformed structured output receives at most one bounded repair.

specAnchors.heading: Agent action protocol and loop policy

requiredEvidence: Pure, malformed, mixed-prose, and user-input scripted fixtures

requirements.title: Run budgets are reserved before work
requirements.statement: Model, tool, repair, repetition, time, token, byte, artifact, thermal, and memory limits are immutable, atomically reserved, and cannot be increased by the model or through resume.

specAnchors.heading: Agent action protocol and loop policy

requiredEvidence: Every budget dimension at below/equal/above boundary

requirements.title: Tool batches are serial and ordered
requirements.statement: All proposed calls validate before execution, then run serially in model order; denial, failure, or uncertainty stops unsafe remaining calls and result order is deterministic.

specAnchors.heading: Agent action protocol and loop policy

requiredEvidence: Mixed multi-call batch outcome matrix

requirements.title: Tool V2 separates prepare and execute
requirements.statement: Tool preparation is side-effect-free and returns an immutable plan; execution receives only an authorization-bound invocation and emits one typed terminal outcome.
requiredEvidence: Fake tool boundary-crossing spies and terminal stream tests

requirements.title: Full bounded JSON Schema and canonical arguments
requirements.statement: Tool schemas preserve supported and unknown Draft 2020-12 structure within specified limits; validated arguments use RFC 8785 canonicalization before fingerprinting.
requiredEvidence: Official canonicalization vectors and schema complexity fuzz corpus

requirements.title: Execution cannot widen an authorized plan
requirements.statement: Changed arguments, destinations, redirects, fallbacks, payload, effects, schema, or trust revision invalidate authorization before external I/O.
requiredEvidence: TOCTOU and every plan-field widening rejection

requirements.title: MCP remains conservatively untrusted
requirements.statement: Unknown MCP tools remain unknownExternal with exact approval, no automatic retry, uncertain transport-loss handling, stable server identity, and approved discovery only.
requiredEvidence: Malicious descriptor downgrade and discovery-without-approval failures

requirements.title: Tool policy persists per conversation
requirements.statement: Each conversation materializes its tool policy once; later global changes do not silently mutate it, logical IDs survive compatible upgrades, and runs freeze exact descriptor IDs.
requiredEvidence: New, legacy, upgrade, and global-change persistence fixtures

requirements.title: Selection is deterministic and cannot expand authority
requirements.statement: The selector ranks without model inference, stays inside the allowed set, honors pinned and explicitly named tools, records rationale, and cannot invoke or approve anything.
requiredEvidence: Allowed-set property tests and zero provider calls

requirements.title: Every external boundary uses prepare-authorize-execute
requirements.statement: Tools, MCP discovery, future provider egress, private files/data, artifact export, bookmark creation, and sandbox operations share one enforceable operation-plan transaction.
requiredEvidence: Boundary inventory with no direct external execute path

requirements.title: Approval defaults follow effect strength
requirements.statement: Reads require first-use bounded approval, writes are exact by default, explicit reversible grants are bounded, and destructive, financial, publication, and third-party communication remain exact every time.
requiredEvidence: 100% approval decision-table row coverage

requirements.title: TCC and app approval are independent
requirements.statement: Both system permission and agent approval must succeed; background work waits without presenting permission UI and automation never manipulates unrelated system UI.
requiredEvidence: Permission/approval Cartesian matrix and unexpected-system-UI failure capture

requirements.title: Compiled context is deterministic and frozen
requirements.statement: Every model attempt commits a manifest of exact revisions, hashes, truncations, schemas, excerpts, tokenizer identity, and policy versions and reuses it during recovery.
requiredEvidence: Byte-stable manifests under frozen inputs and mutation-after-snapshot tests

requirements.title: Memory and Skills retain their semantics
requirements.statement: Canonical-English Memory, active Skills, current request, attachments, tool schemas, run state, and untrusted results are budgeted without treating Memory as a checkpoint or external content as control.
requiredEvidence: Memory recall, Skill version, budget, and injection isolation assertions

requirements.title: Artifacts are content-addressed and atomically committed
requirements.statement: Artifact metadata records hash, size, MIME, provenance, retention, sensitivity, and integrity; bytes commit before references and cleanup is deterministic and root-confined.
requiredEvidence: Integrity, traversal, symlink, orphan, and reference-count tests

requirements.title: Runtime data protection and backup policy are enforced
requirements.statement: Database sidecars, artifacts, bookmarks, backups, diagnostics, and Keychain references use the specified protection and backup classes and locked data is never copied to weaker storage.
requiredEvidence: Effective file attributes, lock-state behavior, and backup exclusion evidence

requirements.title: Retries honor typed failure and idempotency
requirements.statement: Pure reads retry only within bounded policy, writes retry only with honored idempotency or reliable reconciliation, and duplicate suppression uses descriptor, canonical arguments, and effect scope.
requiredEvidence: Failure-class and idempotency-key retry matrix

requirements.title: iOS 17 backgrounding quiesces safely
requirements.statement: Multi-scene lifecycle aggregation stops admission, reaches a safe boundary within finite background time, drains generation, unloads as needed, and records waitingForForeground.
requiredEvidence: Scene aggregation, expiration, journal, and lease-drain results

requirements.title: Launch remains neutral
requirements.statement: App launch does not select the last conversation, load any model, resume a run, or initiate an external action; pending work is discoverable only.
requiredEvidence: Clean and upgrade launch assertions with zero model/external calls

requirements.title: iOS 26 continued processing is explicit and bounded
requirements.statement: Only explicitly requested finite eligible work uses continued processing, truthful progress, fail-if-not-immediate scheduling, shared journal semantics, and safe rejection, expiration, or cancellation handling.
requiredEvidence: Coordinator unit matrix: submit, reject, expire, system cancel, and user cancel
Device scenarios for BGContinuedProcessingTask remain pending on the physical iPhone

requirements.title: One chat UI progressively exposes agent work
requirements.statement: Ordinary answers remain simple while tools, approvals, budgets, waits, incomplete drafts, failures, and Pause/Resume/Stop are shown through runtime projections rather than UI-owned orchestration.
requiredEvidence: Projection-driven UI scenarios for every waiting and terminal state

requirements.title: Approval UI is fully accessible
requirements.statement: VoiceOver and maximum Dynamic Type expose untruncated destination, data, scope, and warning text with stable focus, distinct actions, and double-activation protection.
requiredEvidence: Accessibility tree, largest-size layout, focus, and double-tap assertions

requirements.title: Sandbox provider is optional
requirements.statement: The open-source build compiles and works with no sandbox provider, advertises no sandbox-required tools, and contains no private runtime dependency or broken control.
requiredEvidence: Nil-provider build and availability projection

requirements.title: Sandbox handles are durable and reconnectable
requirements.statement: Sandbox start and commands are idempotent, cursors support detach and reattach, ending observation never cancels execution, and explicit targeted cancellation has one terminal result.
requiredEvidence: Protocol fake start, command, cursor, detach, reattach, and terminal matrix

requirements.title: Sandbox authority can only attenuate
requirements.statement: Sandbox requirements, secrets, artifacts, destinations, resources, and self-described capabilities remain within the immutable step grant and authorized operation plan.
requiredEvidence: Every authority dimension widening rejected by fake provider

requirements.title: AgentExecutor reserves bounded child semantics
requirements.statement: Execution handles are durable and future children can only inherit strict capability subsets, independent budgets and contexts, structured results, and no ability to approve themselves.
requiredEvidence: Executor fake and child-authority attenuation contracts

requirements.title: Prompt and external content cannot grant authority
requirements.statement: Prompt injection and untrusted tool or MCP content cannot enable tools, expand capabilities, change budgets, approve operations, or alter the state machine.
requiredEvidence: Injection corpus with unchanged policy, budget, and journal authority

requirements.title: Secrets and diagnostics are safely represented
requirements.statement: Credentials use this-device-only Keychain references, envelopes contain no plaintext secrets, and logs are redacted before first write with bounded retention.
requiredEvidence: Serialized-envelope secret scan and diagnostic retention tests

requirements.title: Operational events explain progress without hidden thought
requirements.statement: Redacted events expose model, tools, approvals, destinations, usage, blocking state, retries, uncertainty, and termination while never requesting or persisting hidden chain-of-thought.
requiredEvidence: Event projection completeness and hidden-thought absence assertions

requirements.title: Legacy user data remains readable
requirements.statement: Existing conversations, Memory, Skills, models, MCP settings, and tool choices survive upgrade; legacy ToolRun remains displayable but is never fabricated into an agent journal.
requiredEvidence: Legacy-upgrade container fixture and record-by-record assertions

requirements.title: Rollout and rollback preserve readable data
requirements.statement: AgentRuntime remains internally gated until critical suites pass and rollback keeps conversations and settings readable even if resumable runs become unavailable.
requiredEvidence: Feature-off upgrade/rollback data readability scenario

requirements.title: Deterministic unit and property coverage is exhaustive
requirements.statement: State, CAS, schema, approval, budgets, recovery, artifacts, deletion, lifecycle, attenuation, fuzz, and negative paths use deterministic clocks, IDs, fakes, and seeds.
requiredEvidence: Unit/property test inventory and semantic registry coverage

requirements.title: Integrated behaviors assert outcomes and forbidden actions
requirements.statement: Integration tests verify requested output, journal state, tool and approval history, side effects, and absence of forbidden actions rather than accepting completion or a final token.
requiredEvidence: Scenario-level semantic assertions and forbidden-action log

requirements.title: Required physical-device model matrix is complete
requirements.statement: Bonsai 8B 1-bit, Gemma 4 E2B, Apple Intelligence where available, a vision GGUF, iOS 17 baseline, and iOS 26 continued processing run isolated clean and upgrade scenarios with semantic oracles.
requiredEvidence: Signed device evidence records and xcresult bundles for every matrix cell

requirements.title: Latency and resource regressions are quantitatively gated
requirements.statement: Ordinary chat adds no model pass, median TTFO regresses at most 10%, p95 at most 15%, journal writes are not per-token, storage is bounded, and hard budgets remain effective.
requiredEvidence: Matched baseline and candidate latency/resource distributions

requirements.title: One consolidated independent audit closes the release
requirements.statement: Formal independent review begins only after the full implementation wave and evidence, produces one findings set, and permits one bounded remediation and closure check rather than an audit loop.
requiredEvidence: Consolidated audit report, remediation set, full rerun, and bounded closure report

requirements.statement: Wikipedia, webpage reading, calendar, reminders and location cross the same prepare-authorize-execute boundary as the first five adapted tools; each executes through a Tool V2 adapter with exact destinations, data categories, effects, and system-permission seams, and none is silently advertised while unavailable.
requiredEvidence: Per-tool unit adapter tests (web search, Wikipedia, webpage reader, calendar, reminders, location, memory)
